integrity: Theorem is proved by an exact topological criterion, gap-density change of variables, bounded Taylor remainder, and strict harmonic inequalities. Finite numerical tests support but do not replace the proof.
scientific_limitations: Fixed n>=4, strictly positive C3 periodic density, first radius interval only; remainder not uniform in n. General related coverage literature may have implicit overlap. No independent validation.
title: Quadratic onset and harmonic resonance of nonuniform random-circle Rips loops
